|notes=The 31 December 2003 supplement states that Boba Fett uses the Cloud City persona. The [https://web.archive.org/web/20040707195107id_/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/Resources/rulessheet020904.pdf#page=1 February 2004 ruling] verifies the same persona. Both full forms retain the Bounty pull, Aim High immunity, fly movement and conditional battle destiny.
